verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a laptop processor (hardware), not a service that collects user data. A training-data opt-out control is a category error for this kind of product. Mentions of on-device AI running locally describe where inference runs, not a data-use or training opt-out control the product provides.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
